statement: Explain fundamental database concepts, DBMS architecture and the major data models.
Design entity-relationship models for a given requirement and translate them into relational schemas.
Formulate SQL statements involving joins, nested subqueries and aggregate functions to retrieve required information.
Analyse functional dependencies of a relation and normalise it up to BCNF.
Evaluate transaction management, concurrency-control and recovery techniques for a given workload.
Assess indexing and query-optimisation strategies and recommend an appropriate plan for a given query.
